answer_format: End your reply with a final line that contains \boxed{<answer>}.

rules.normalisation: hotpot_evaluate_v1.py normalize_answer: lower case; characters of string.punctuation removed; \b(a|an|the)\b replaced by a space; white space collapsed
rules.f1: token F1 of the normalised strings; 0 when either normalises to yes, no or noanswer and they differ; 0 when no token is shared
rules.strict: content of the last complete box (braces matched, backslash escapes the next character), text wrappers replaced by their contents, '$' removed, stripped
rules.lenient: strict; else a final unclosed box's content; else the rest of the line after the last answer cue; else the last non-empty line (each unwrapped as strict)
rules.compliance: strict answer exists and normalises to a non-empty string
rules.primary: strict exact match; strict F1 and lenient scores beside it
